name: @laracms-theme/chainlite
description: Chainlite theme build (Tailwind v4) – isolated from admin/Vite.
author: You

scripts.build: npm run prebuild && npm run build:css && npm run postbuild:css
scripts.clean: node -e "try{require('fs').rmSync('assets/dist', { recursive: true, force: true })}catch(e){}" && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('assets/dist', { recursive: true })"
